title: Eight O'Clock Coffee The Original Ground Coffee, Medium Roast, 21 Ounce (Pack of 1) - Sweet, Fruity, Well Balanced

reviews.title: Good for cold brew
reviews.body: enjoyed this coffee with my coffee maker. got mild fruity taste and you can enjoy it doing cold brew
reviews.author: Ronnell Cordero

reviews.title: Good medium roast coffee
reviews.body: Although this is a medium roast coffee the strength is just right. Less aromatic but goes very well with fresh milk. I bought this coffee when it was on offer  but now the price has shot up considerably.
reviews.author: Thanapal

reviews.title: Average Coffee
reviews.body: It smells so good in the bag. However, the coffee is a bit bitter for me and lack of significant note. I usually drink coffee in medium body. This one is a medium-dark roast.
reviews.author: Janti Tang

reviews.title: Smells so good
reviews.body: Oh wow so fragrant Just worth the wait .. Greatful it finally arrived So now my mother can sit and enjoy her 8oclock coffee 😊
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.title: Good coffee, good price.  What more do you want?
reviews.body: The thing about coffee is there seems to be a high degree of brand loyalty. Different brands taste pretty significantly different. People start out with a certain brand, learn to associate that aroma & taste with coffee. (I know that doesn't explain the horrid swill served up at Starbuck's, but what really would?)I've been drinking eight o'clock for half a century. It has a rich, mellow flavor and does the important work - waking me up.Coffee prices have gone through the roof for several reasons,none of them good. This is a very good price for a very good coffee.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 9 July 2026
reviews.author: The house on the corner

reviews.title: Good Quality Coffee!
reviews.body: I bought this for my grandmother for christmas as part of a set of other things. The taste of the coffee is amazing. It is the only kind she will drink. The strength is good, she loves strong coffee and the aroma is really strong but it os a good kind of strong. The size was good too, you can get the most value for money with this bag.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 26 March 2026
reviews.author: Jake

reviews.title: Esta rico, pero lo siento caro
reviews.body: Es uno de los que más me ha gustado pero lo sentí un poco caro para el café de diario, si lo volvería a comprar sin duda para ocasiones especiales
